title: Personal Sender Account Tenure Days on a Reactivated Cash Pickup
content:
**Sender accounts note.** A reactivated Cash Pickup pickup receives tenure days. They follow the sender's Personal Sender Account whose status is active, and they turn on the account's level and its months open together. Months open are the whole calendar months from the opening date to the day of the reactivation.

| Personal Sender Account (active) | Days added to the reactivated window |
|---|---|
| open at least 24 months, level Paloma Enhanced, Paloma Premier or Paloma Private Client | 2 |
| open at least 12 months, level Paloma Verified or Paloma Verified Plus | 1 |
| any other account | none |

The days are whole calendar days and move the last day of collection later.

## Combinations (hypothetical accounts)

| Level | Whole months open | Days |
|---|---|---|
| Paloma Enhanced | 30 | 2 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 20 | none |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 26 | 1 |
| Paloma Verified | 9 | none |
| Paloma Starter | 40 | none |

A Paloma Enhanced account open 20 months gives none. It is short of 24 months, and the 12-month band is for Paloma Verified and Paloma Verified Plus only.
